name: broken-reference-remove-referenced-interface
description: A `remove` of an element two ports still reference. Validation runs over the staged result, so the refusal names every dangling referrer at once rather than stopping at the first guard.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. `IExample` is provided by `ExampleSWC.pOut` and required by `ExampleConsumerSWC.rIn`; the change set removes the interface and clears neither port.

expected.notes: The addresses are the referrers, not the removed element: that is what a client needs to write the change set that succeeds. Adding the two port removals — or two `update`s pointing them elsewhere — to this same change set makes it acceptable as a whole, so a removal needs no separate refusal guard or confirmation-token round trip.
